verdict.rationale: Dagster's docs show schedules that run jobs at hourly, daily, or weekly intervals or on cron expressions [dagster-docs-31]. Declarative Automation's AutomationCondition.on_cron runs assets once per cron tick after upstream dependencies update [dagster-docs-38], sensors add event-driven triggers [dagster-docs-5], and a long-running daemon is part of the standard deployment [dagster-docs-12]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling, and no evidence that schedules can be created or managed from an AI session (the MCP server is described only generically).
